python3 - <<'PYREPLAY'
from pathlib import Path
import hashlib, importlib
expected=(Path.cwd() / 'src/exceptiongroup/_formatting.py').resolve()
try:
 module = importlib.import_module('exceptiongroup._formatting')
except Exception as import_error:
 traceback=import_error.__traceback__
 while traceback is not None:
  file=traceback.tb_frame.f_globals.get('__file__')
  if file and Path(file).resolve()==expected:
   print('source_binding', str(expected), 'sha256', hashlib.sha256(expected.read_bytes()).hexdigest(), 'actual_import_failure_frame')
  traceback=traceback.tb_next
 raise
actual=Path(module.__file__).resolve()
print("source_binding", str(actual), "sha256", hashlib.sha256(actual.read_bytes()).hexdigest())
assert actual == expected, (actual, expected)
import sys
from exceptiongroup._formatting import _compute_suggestion_error
print("task_python",sys.version)
assert sys.version_info[:2]==(3,10)
try:
 folder
except NameError as error:
 suggestion=_compute_suggestion_error(error,error.__traceback__)
 print("name_suggestion",suggestion)
 assert suggestion=="filter"
try:
 [].attend
except AttributeError as error:
 suggestion=_compute_suggestion_error(error,error.__traceback__)
 print("attribute_suggestion",suggestion)
 assert suggestion=="append"
PYREPLAY
